initial_prompt: Can you write a short poem about a clock that has stopped working?

messages.content: Can you write a short poem about a clock that has stopped working?

The gears have sighed and settled down,
No longer chasing seconds round.
The brass and dust have made a pact
To leave the final hour intact.

It holds a moment, crisp and still,
Against the rushing world’s will.
A quiet face, a frozen chime—
The peace of stepping out of time.
